subject: Rename redisError to serverError (#177)
reason: The change is a pure refactor: the struct 'redisError' is renamed to 'serverError' in server.h and its two use sites in server.c (incrementErrorCount and the INFO errorstat section). The struct layout and all logic are byte-for-byte identical; no command reply, data path, replication, or persistence behavior changes, so no scenario can distinguish the builds.
